def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find connected 5 shapes (4-conn)
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; shapes=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==5 and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==5 and not seen[x][y]:
                            seen[x][y]=True; st.append((x,y))
                shapes.append(cells)
    for cells in shapes:
        rs=[c[0] for c in cells]; cs=[c[1] for c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        # gap column in top row of bbox
        gaps=[c for c in range(c0,c1+1) if g[r0][c]==0]
        # interior: 0-cells strictly inside bbox
        interior=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)
                  if g[r][c]==0 and r>r0 and r<r1]
        for r,c in interior: g[r][c]=2
        gc=gaps[0]
        lr=r0-1
        # direction: away from adjacent wall
        if gc+1<=c1 and g[r0][gc+1]==5:  # wall on right -> go left
            for c in range(0,gc+1): g[lr][c]=2
        else:
            for c in range(gc,W): g[lr][c]=2
    return g
